text:
Platinum Price in 2016
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2016, the LBMA platinum price rose 3.7% between 2016-01-29 ($866) and 2016-12-29 ($898). The highest sampled price was $1,143 in July and the lowest was $866 in January. The mean of these observations was $985. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
